result.topic_en: On the left, Riemann expresses particular solutions of the Legendre-type differential equation in t through hypergeometric series in several variables and tabulates their exponents; on the right, he begins a note 'On the potential of a ring', discussing Laplace's equation and the boundary conditions that determine the potential.
